work.title: Concerto grosso in D major, Op. 6 No. 4

version.value: Opening Adagio–Allegro movement of the four-movement concerto grosso
version.note: The recording page identifies the movement. The original concertino/ripieno scoring is used as the editorial reference; the performers’ edition and exact continuo realization are not documented.

performers.note: The source separately calls Elias Goldstein managing director. A management credit is not a conducting or solo-performance credit; concertino players are not named.

date.note: The source states selections from the 05–06 season, not an exact session date. The Commons upload on 11 February 2008 is separate.

place.note: No specific performance venue or recording location is supplied.

label.note: The Al Goldstein collection/Pandora repository is the source collection, not an established original record label.

catalogue.note: No original catalogue number is documented.

composition.note: Corelli died in 1713; Op. 6 was published in 1714. The composition’s status is separate from rights in this modern performance.

recording.note: The Commons page explicitly supplies the EFF Open Audio License and its CC BY-SA 2.0 replacement terms for this recording. CC BY-SA 2.0 is selected here.
